_help: Where every image and sound comes from. Paths start at the public/ folder.
A path WITHOUT an extension (assets/image/moon) picks up moon.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .gif or .svg — whichever you dropped in. Sounds: .mp3, .ogg, .wav or .m4a.
A path ending in / is a FOLDER: every file in it is used (voice blips are picked at random). For stars and researchPoints, the first image in the folder is used.
realEquipment = folder of real photos for the "i" cards: <id>, or <id>-1, <id>-2, ... for a gallery.
{x} = the resolution folder: x1 (base size), x2 (2x the pixels) or x3 (3x the pixels). Use the SAME file name in all three. x1 alone is enough; the site picks the sharpest file it needs.
A missing planet or background image falls back to the built-in drawing. A missing sound is simply silent.

JPEG has no transparency: use PNG or WebP for the rocket, Nova, stars, cursor and research-points icon. JPEG is fine for the background, planets (cropped to a circle) and equipment (shown inside a frame).

cursor: size = on-screen size in CSS px (max 42 so x3 stays under the browser's 128 px limit). hotspot = the exact click point [x, y] in x1 pixels. Both are written by `npm run cursors` from cursor/originals/; change size and re-run it.

sounds._help: music: one looping track per screen (normal = title, intro, planets, bonus, Pioneer 10's story, ending, credits; moon / mars = that planet's surface + its equipment; quiz = every quiz). Write a track as a path, or as { "file": path, "volume": 0.8 } to make just that track quieter/louder (multiplies volume.music). voices.equipment = the default voice for equipment without their own "voice" in content/equipment/<id>.json. voiceEveryNLetters only applies to short blips (Nova); long voice clips play one slice per word.
